'''Disch'l''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Believers]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Disch'l became involved in a Believer plot to release a [[virus]] into the atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], to kill the planet's indigenous species, the [[Caarite]]s. Along with the Believers [[Crymsin Ost]] and [[Eph]]; and the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]], Disch'l infiltrated the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Creautaa-V]], that was orbiting the planet. They released the virus, killing all the Caarites aboard it. They then planned to send the virus to down to the planet in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] learned of the plot and confronted Disch'l and his comrades aboard the station. In the resulting fight, Disch'l created a number of [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusions]] of Crymsin Ost to confuse the heroes. However, the heroes were eventually victorious and Disch'l and the other Believers were prevented from sending the virus to the planet.
